profile.role_note: A free healer and buffer for any team. Her Outro deepens the whole team's DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free, and she fits everywhere. Claim her from the standard selector if you have not. She fits every team that is not running Shorekeeper.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Variation (or Stellar Symphony) + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Fallacy of No Return in the main slot. Use a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, and ATK% 1-costs. Stack as much Energy Regen as possible. Her 175-energy Liberation is her whole rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: The classic Verina weapon, and the community's agreed number 1 pick. It gives Energy Regen, plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill. Easy to get, and excellent.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Shorekeeper's signature. It gives strong Energy Regen and HP%, plus team ATK on heal. A premium alternative — but it is not hers.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Free at Union Level 45. Its ATK% substat boosts her ATK-scaling heals, and it gives a little Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Rectifier#25
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen, with a small ATK boost. Some guides recommend it over Cosmic Ripples.

ranked_weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
ranked_weapons.note: Healing and Energy Regen. A solid free option. Free last resort: the 3-star Rectifier of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Boosts her healing. It grants the team 15% ATK for 30s. Bell-Borne Geochelone is a popular main-echo alternative, for its shield.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen, plus an ATK buff for the next Resonator. It loses some healing and the all-team buff.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is standard; ATK% works since her heals scale off ATK.
ATK% on both; feeds her ATK-scaling heals.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; as high as possible (Liberation costs 175 energy)

teams.name: Classic: Jiyan + Mortefi + Verina

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: Launch-era AoE carry; in his Liberation state every attack is a fast Heavy Attack.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG; his Liberation turret fires on Heavy and Basic Attacks.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals and buffs; her Outro's All-Type DMG Deepen affects the whole team.

teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team alive and buffed. Mortefi drops his Liberation turret and Outros for the 38% Heavy Attack buff. Then Jiyan enters his Liberation state and tears in with rapid Heavy Attacks.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Iuno + Verina

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry that benefits from Verina's all-type DMG Deepen.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks for Augusta.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Universal healer/buffer; a documented pairing for the Augusta/Iuno duo.

teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team alive and deepens its damage. Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle for Heavy Attack buffs and Wan Light stacks. Then Augusta takes her long Heavy Attack window.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete healer and buffer. Aim for S2 for faster rotations. S6 is whales only.

pull_path.why: Full healing plus 15% all-type DMG and 20% ATK buffs at S0.
+1 Photosynthesis Energy and +10 Concerto on skill — the rotation shortcut both guides flag.
Starflower Blooms trigger coordinated attacks that heal the team.

nodes.name: Moment of Emergence
nodes.effect: Outro grants the next character 20% of ATK as healing every 5s for 30s.

nodes.name: Sprouting Reflections
nodes.effect: Botany Experiment grants +1 Photosynthesis Energy and 10 Concerto Energy.

nodes.name: Blossoming Embrace
nodes.effect: Starflower Blooms, Liberation, and Outro grant the team +15% Spectro DMG for 24s.

nodes.name: Miraculous Blooms
nodes.effect: Healing +20% when the target is under 50% HP.

nodes.name: Joyous Harvest
nodes.effect: Starflower Blooms +20% DMG, triggering a coordinated attack that heals nearby allies.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: She has no 5-star signature. Variation is the agreed best pick, and it is easy to get. Skip dupes entirely — S2 at most.
